description: Module used to test new features, it's set in the sprawling world of Varnfell and includes a more rogue-like experience with randomly generated dungeons.
trailer: You and your group of flunkies have found yourselves stranded on the shores of the untamed world of Varnfell. Varnfell is a place that has been abandoned by the gods where the people are forced to live under the tyranny of The Deep Ones, a god-like race that controls all the healing power in the lands of Varnfell.
